notes: Built-in Nintendo DS player (Gen 4–5)! Diamond/Pearl/Platinum, HeartGold/SoulSilver and Black/White now run in the app on Windows and Android via the melonDS core — dual-screen layout with a real touch screen (mouse on desktop, stylus on phone), on-screen touch controls in portrait, remappable keyboard/controller input, audio and fast-forward. Encrypted retail DS ROMs need Nintendo DS BIOS files: import your own bios7/bios9/firmware under Settings → Built-in DS player → Nintendo DS BIOS (decrypted ROMs work without them). Also fixes a fast-forward freeze on the DS core.
